Explanation:

○ 2nd capture group.
○ Match '/'.

○ 3rd capture group.
○ Match a character other than '\n' greedily any number of times.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.

member.remarks:

○ Match the string "http".
○ Match 's' atomically, optionally.
○ Match the string "://".
○ Match the string "www.".
○ Match a character in the set [^\t-\r []] greedily at least once.
○ Match if at a word boundary.
